# Open Source Software Used

## libboundscheck

### Code Source Description

This repository is depended upon by the compiler and surrounding components. The
repository source code is located at
[third_party_bounds_checking_function](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/third_party_bounds_checking_function),
version
[OpenHarmony-v6.0-Release](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/third_party_bounds_checking_function/tags/OpenHarmony-v6.0-Release).

This open source software is used by the compiler and surrounding components by
including header files and depends on it through linking libraries (dynamic or
static libraries).

### Build Instructions

This repository is included as a subtarget project via CMake. The build process
will automatically complete the build and establish dependencies. For specific
build parameters, please refer to the [CMakeLists.txt](./cmake/CMakeLists.txt)
file.

## FlatBuffers

### Code Source Notes

FlatBuffers is a high-performance cross-platform, cross-language serialization
library. The Cangjie language uses the FlatBuffers library to perform
serialization and deserialization operations on compiler data to specified
formats.

This open-source software is used by compilers and related components by
including header files and by linking libraries (dynamic or static libraries).

### Build Notes

This repository is included as a subtarget project via CMake. The build process
will automatically complete the build and establish dependencies. For specific
build parameters, please refer to the
[Flatbuffer.cmake](./cmake/Flatbuffer.cmake) file.

Developers can also manually download the source code for
[flatbuffers](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/third_party_flatbuffers.git) using
the following command:

```shell
mkdir -p third_party/flatbuffers
cd third_party/flatbuffers
git clone https://gitcode.com/openharmony/third_party_flatbuffers.git -b master ./
```

When building the project, the source code in the third_party/flatbuffers
directory will be used directly for the build process.

## LLVM

### Code Source Explanation

LLVM, as the backend of the Cangjie compiler, is currently based on the official
code repository
[llvmorg-15.0.4](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/third_party_llvm-project)
(corresponding to commit 5c68a1cb123161b54b72ce90e7975d95a8eaf2a4) open-source
version. To facilitate code management and support HarmonyOS builds, LLVM uses
two source sources during builds:

- From the repository https://gitcode.com/Cangjie/llvm-project/, using this
  repository as the default for convenient daily code development, review, and
  management.

- This build originates from the repository
  https://gitcode.com/openharmony/third_party_llvm-project (with the commit hash
  corresponding to llvmorg-15.0.4), and includes llvmPatch.diff for building.
  This method is primarily used for OpenHarmony builds.

llvmPatch.diff is generated after verification based on changes made to the
https://gitcode.com/Cangjie/llvm-project/ repository, ensuring patch
availability for each version. It's important to note that LLVM version upgrades
must be evaluated for feasibility in conjunction with OpenHarmony community
open-source software upgrade requirements to ensure OpenHarmony version
availability.

### Build Instructions

This repository is included as a sub-target project via CMake. The compilation
process will automatically build the code and establish dependencies.

When the option "--use-oh-llvm-repo" is used, the build process defaults to
using the code from the
[third_party_llvm-project](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/third_party_llvm-project)
repository along with llvmPatch.diff.

Developers can also manually download the source code of
[third_party_llvm-project](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/third_party_llvm-project)
and apply the patch file using the following commands:

```shell
mkdir -p third_party/llvm-project
cd third_party/llvm-project
git clone -b master --depth 1 https://gitcode.com/openharmony/third_party_llvm-project ./
git fetch --depth 1 origin 5c68a1cb123161b54b72ce90e7975d95a8eaf2a4
git checkout 5c68a1cb123161b54b72ce90e7975d95a8eaf2a4
git apply --reject --whitespace=fix ../llvmPatch.diff
```

Or pull directly
[Cangjie/llvm-project](https://gitcode.com/Cangjie/llvm-project/):

```shell
mkdir -p third_party/llvm-project
cd third_party/llvm-project
git clone -b main --depth 1 https://gitcode.com/Cangjie/llvm-project.git ./
```

When building the project, the source code in the third_party/llvm-project
directory is used directly for building.

## MinGW-w64

### Code Source Explanation

The Cangjie Windows SDK includes some static library files from MinGW, which are
linked together with the target files generated by the Cangjie code to generate
the final executable binary file that can call the Windows API.

```shell
mkdir -p third_party/llvm-project
cd third_party/llvm-project
git clone -b main --depth 1 https://gitcode.com/Cangjie/llvm-project.git ./
```

```shell
mkdir -p third_party/llvm-project
cd third_party/llvm-project
git clone -b main --depth 1 https://gitcode.com/Cangjie/llvm-project.git ./
```

```shell
mkdir -p third_party/llvm-project
cd third_party/llvm-project
git clone -b main --depth 1 https://gitcode.com/Cangjie/llvm-project.git ./
```

```shell
mkdir -p third_party/llvm-project
cd third_party/llvm-project
```
... Some artifacts from this repository will be packaged into the Cangjie
release package and compiled based on the open-source repository
[third_party_mingw-w64
12.0.0](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/third_party_mingw-w64/commit/feea9a87fa42591b298b18fe0e07198f0b8c2f63?ref=master).

This open-source software is used by the compiler and surrounding components by
including header files and depends on it through linking libraries (dynamic or
static libraries).

### Build Notes

This open-source software is required when the target platform is Windows.

This open-source software must be completed before building the compiler, and
its compilation artifact path must be specified when building the compiler. For
detailed build instructions for MinGW-w64, please refer to the [Build
Guide](https://gitcode.com/Cangjie/cangjie_build/blob/main/docs/linux_cross_windows_zh.md#23-%E7%BC%96%E8%AF%91mingw-w64%E5%8F%8A%E9%85%8D%E5%A5%97%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E9%93%BE-%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E6%AD%A5%E9%AA%A4).
